h:
我决定重新审视我原来的快速 Turbo XL 到 SD1.5 工作流程（https://civitai.com/models/217808/cjs-super-simple-sdxl-turbo-to-sd-15-workflow）利用去年在稳定扩散方面取得的进步。

此工作流程不再仅限于 Turbo。您应该能够使用任何 SDXL（或 XL 相关）检查点。同样，如果您愿意调整和测试设置，您可以将其完全限制为仅 SDXL，包括高档瓷砖！

这里的速度完全来自两个Lora包。 PCM 是作为 LCM 的继承者发布的最新、最好的低步 lora 套装。它不再仅限于 LCM 采样器，它提供了更多的灵活性。 SPO 代表“步骤感知偏好优化”，是 DPO 的继承者。 SPO locon lora 是从 SPO 检查点中提取出来的，可用于任何 SDXL 检查点。

该工作流程可用于很多不同的事情，但我最喜欢的是图像的实时合成。如果您希望将其用于实时图像合成，请将种子设置为“新固定随机”并确保“高档”组已关闭/绕过。在侧面菜单中，选中“额外选项”，然后打开“自动队列”。按“队列提示”并输入。一旦您构建了喜欢的图像，您就可以关闭“自动队列”并激活“高档”组。

从最初的推理到最终放大为 2048x3072 的图像，使用我的 4090FE 生成的总时间约为 20 秒。

请注意，此工作流程存在局限性。也就是说，与使用不同模型的任何 Img2Img 生成一样，您的图像在每次传递之间都会发生一些变化。如果事情不像您想要的那样，请尝试更改种子或修改提示。您还可以查看调整 SD1.5 ksampler 的降噪级别。我通常发现 0.40 到 0.65 之间效果很好。任何更高或更低的值都会导致图像模糊或混乱，所以我不推荐它。 0.60 降噪仍然是我首选的降噪水平。

希望你玩得开心！如果有需求，我可能会推出一个 SDXL 检查点

o.en:
I decided to revisit my original rapid Turbo XL to SD1.5 workflow (https://civitai.com/models/217808/cjs-super-simple-sdxl-turbo-to-sd-15-workflow) to harness the advancements that have been made over the last year for Stable Diffusion.

This workflow is no longer limited to Turbo only. You should be able to use any SDXL (or XL related) checkpoint with it. Similarly, if you're willing to tweak and test settings, you can keep this entirely limited to SDXL only, including tile upscale!

The speed here comes entirely from two Lora packs. PCM is the latest and greatest low-step lora set released as a sort of a successor to LCM. It is no longer limited to just the LCM sampler which offers a lot more flexibility. SPO stands for Step-aware Preference Optimization and is a sort of successor to DPO. The SPO locon lora is distilled from the SPO checkpoint for use on any SDXL checkpoint.

The workflow can be used for a lot of different things, but my favorite is live composition of images. If you wish to use this for live image composition, set seed to "New Fixed Random" and make sure the "Upscale" group is turned off/bypassed. In the side menu, check "Extra options", and then turn on "Auto Queue". Press "Queue Prompt" and type away. Once you've built an image you like, then you can turn off "Auto Queue" and activate the "Upscale" group.

From initial inference to final upscaled image at 2048x3072, total time for generation with my 4090FE is ~20 seconds.

Please note that there are limitations with this workflow. Namely, as with any Img2Img generation that using different models, your images will change some between each pass. If things aren't looking how you'd like them, try changing the seed or modifying your prompt. You can also look at adjusting the denoise level of the SD1.5 ksampler. I've generally found between 0.40 to 0.65 to work well. Anything higher or lower will result in blurry or chaotic images, so I don't recommend it. 0.60 denoise remains my preferred denoise level.

Hope you have fun! If there is demand for it, I may roll out a single SDXL checkpoint
